macros.name: bicaption
macros.doc: Both language texts are entered into the appropriate List of . . . , and both texts are numbered.

macros.name: bicontcaption
macros.doc: Bilingual continuation captions can be typeset via the \bicontcaption command.

macros.name: bitwonumcaption
macros.doc: Bilingual captions can be typeset by the \bitwonumcaption command.

macros.name: captiondelim
macros.doc: The command \captiondelim{⟨delim⟩} can be used to change the delimeter.

macros.name: captionnamefont
macros.doc: The ⟨font⟩ specified by \captionnamefont{⟨font⟩} is used for typesetting the caption name; that is, the first part of the caption upto and including the delimeter (e.g., the portion ‘Table 3:’). ⟨font⟩ can be any kind of font specification and/or command and/or text.

macros.name: captiontitlefont
macros.doc: The font for the caption title.

macros.name: centerlastline
macros.doc: The \centerlastline style gives a block paragraph but with the last line centered.

macros.name: changecaptionwidth
macros.doc: Issuing the command \changecaptionwidth will cause the captions to be typeset within a total width ⟨length⟩ as specified by \captionwidth{⟨length⟩}.

macros.name: contcaption
macros.doc: The \contcaption{⟨text⟩} command can be used to put a ‘continuation’ or ‘concluded’ caption into a float environment.

macros.name: contsubfigure
macros.doc: This a simplified version of \subfigure in that the main caption counter is not incremented (we should be in a continued float), and the subcounter is restored before being incremented.

macros.name: flushleftright
macros.doc: \flushleftright sets the skips to TeX’s normal (block) paragraphing values, while \centerlastline sets the skips to give a centered last line in a block paragraph.

macros.name: hangcaption
macros.doc: The command \hangcaption will cause captions to be typeset with the second and later lines of a multiline caption title indented by the width of the caption name.

macros.name: indentcaption
macros.doc: The command \indentcaption{⟨length⟩} will indent title lines after the first by ⟨length⟩.

macros.name: legend
macros.doc: The \legend{⟨text⟩} command is intended to be used to put an anonymous caption into a float environment, but may be used anywhere.

macros.name: longbicaption
macros.doc: A version of \bicaption for use in a longtable.

macros.name: longbionenumcaption
macros.doc: A version of \bionenumcaption for use in a longtable.

macros.name: midbicaption
macros.doc: The command \midbicaption{⟨midtext⟩}, which is similar to the \precaption and \postcaption commands, is executed just before calling the second \caption.

macros.name: namedlegend
macros.doc: As a convenience, the \namedlegend[⟨short-title⟩]{⟨long-title⟩} command is like the \caption command except that it does not number the caption and, by default, puts no entry into a List of. . . file.

macros.name: newfixedcaption
macros.doc: The \newfixedcaption[⟨capcommand⟩]{⟨command⟩}{⟨env⟩} command, and its friends, can be used to create a new captioning hcommand i that may be used outside the float environment henv i. Both the environment henv i and a captioning command, hcapcommand i, for that environment must have been defined before calling \newfixedcaption.

macros.name: newsubfloat
macros.doc: The \newsubfloat{⟨fenv⟩} command, which is only of use with the subfigure package and the subfigure20 or subfigure option, creates subcaptions (\subtop and \subbottom, together with their continued forms) for use within the float environment hfenv i previously defined via \newfloatlist {⟨fenv⟩}{...}.

macros.name: normalcaption
macros.doc: The \normalcaption command undoes any previous \hangcaption or \indentcaption command.

macros.name: normalcaptionwidth
macros.doc: Issuing the command \normalcaptionwidth will cause captions to be typeset as normal full width captions.

macros.name: postcaption
macros.doc: The commands \precaption{⟨pretext⟩} and \postcaption{⟨posttext⟩} specify ⟨pretext⟩ and ⟨posttext⟩ that will be processed at the start and end of a caption.

macros.name: precaption
macros.doc: The commands \precaption{⟨pretext⟩} and \postcaption{⟨posttext⟩} specify ⟨pretext⟩ and ⟨posttext⟩ that will be processed at the start and end of a caption.

macros.name: subbottom
macros.doc: \subbottom[⟨list-entry⟩][⟨subcaption⟩]{⟨text⟩} typesets a subcaption below the ⟨text⟩.

macros.name: subconcluded
macros.doc: The \subconcluded command is used to indicate that the continued (sub) float has been concluded and the numbering scheme is reinitialized.

macros.name: subtop
macros.doc: \subtop[⟨caption⟩]{⟨text⟩} typesets a subcaption at the top of the subfigure/table.
